_doc: The 6 mm slot of Motedis' I-type profiles (30 mm series). Motedis prints the opening, the lip and the depth, each a little off item's (6 against 6.2, 2,9 against 3.0, 9,9 against 9.75); it sells the section as I-type, made to match item's Line 6 groove, so the cavity's width is item's figures, marked community until a bar is measured. The floor and flanks are item's as scaled off its drawing.
name: slot-6-motedis-i

opening.rule: Slot width, "6" on the data picture ("Nutbreite: 6 mm" on the page)
opening.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-30x30L-I-Typ-Nut-6", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-30x30L-I-Typ-Nut-6

lip_thickness.rule: Lip thickness, "2,9" on the data picture
lip_thickness.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-30x30L-I-Typ-Nut-6", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-30x30L-I-Typ-Nut-6

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: Motedis prints none. item's figure (slot-6-item-light)
cavity_width.source: slot-6-item-light rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

cavity_depth.rule: Slot depth, "9,9" on the data picture
cavity_depth.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-30x30L-I-Typ-Nut-6", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-30x30L-I-Typ-Nut-6

floor_width.rule: Width of the floor: as slot-6-item-light, itself scaled off item's drawing
floor_width.source: slot-6-item-light rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as slot-6-item-light
flank_angle.source: slot-6-item-light rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

nut_family.rule: Sold as I-type: it takes nuts made for item's Line 6 groove
